prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, KPI expectations, and whether you need SEO, paid ads, content, social, web design, B2B demand gen, etc.

If you tell me your priorities I’ll give a tailored short list, but here’s a quick, practical way to find the best fit — plus what I can do next for you.

Questions I need
- What primary services do you need? (SEO, PPC, social, content, email, web design, full-service)
- What’s your monthly/annual budget range for marketing?
- Are you a local SMB, regional business, or enterprise/B2B company?
- Any industries you want the agency to have experience with?
- Timeline / results expectations (3 months, 6 months, 12 months)?

How to evaluate and pick the “best” agency
- Relevant case studies: look for measurable results (traffic, leads, ROAS) for clients like you.
- Industry experience: similar verticals reduce ramp-up time.
- Clear KPIs & reporting cadence: weekly/monthly dashboards and a single point of contact.
- Team vs. rep: who will do the work — senior strategists or offshore juniors?
- Tools & methodology: which platforms and tactics will they use?
- Budget fit and contracts: minimum terms, exit clauses, and fee transparency.
- References: ask for two client references and call them.
- Trial project: start with a 1–3 month pilot to validate results.

What I can do next
- If you give the details above I’ll compile a tailored shortlist of 4–6 St. Louis agencies matched to your needs (with strengths, typical budgets, and sample questions to ask).
- Or I can give a generic shortlist and quick pros/cons if you prefer.

Which would you like?
